title: eval-harness: integrate per-prompt metrics into CI gating and add CI hooks
author: Sofia Chen
release_notes: Add per-prompt metrics collection and CI gating for eval-harness. New GitHub Actions job `eval:per-prompt-gate` enforces quality thresholds to prevent prompt-set regressions.
description:
Summary: Integrates per-prompt metric collection from the eval-harness into CI and wires up a new GitHub Actions hook that fails the pipeline if a prompt-set regression is detected. Motivation: teams have seen flaky quality regressions after model swaps and quantization changes. Per-prompt metrics let us detect regressions at the prompt level and gate merges when regressions exceed configured thresholds. This PR implements metric aggregation, config-driven gates, a CI job that posts a compact report, and lightweight tooling for maintainers to update thresholds.

Commits (high level): - 3a2b1d: add per_prompt_metrics collector to eval-harness core (aggregation + JSON output) - 4b7c9e: expose per-prompt outputs in existing eval CLI and add --per-prompt-output <path> - 8f6d2a: add ci/gate_per_prompt.yml GitHub Actions workflow and a small runner script scripts/ci/per_prompt_gate.py - 9a1c0f: add config schema at eval-harness/config/prompt_gates.yaml and patch README - 0b7e3d: unit tests for collector and gate logic; integration tests stub CI invocation

Files changed (high level): - eval-harness/core/collector.py: new PerPromptCollector class that records metrics per prompt (accuracy/score, confidence, token-level diffs) and emits normalized JSON - eval-harness/cli/run_eval.py: option to produce per-prompt output and attach eval metadata - eval-harness/config/prompt_gates.yaml: new schema with default thresholds for SPEED/QUALITY/CONFIDENCE - .github/workflows/ci.yml: reference to new workflow - .github/workflows/eval-per-prompt-gate.yml: new workflow that runs on PR and nightly for monitored branches - scripts/ci/per_prompt_gate.py: gate runner that compares current run to baseline and posts GitHub PR check details - tests/test_per_prompt_collector.py, tests/test_per_prompt_gate.py: unit tests and small fixtures - docs/eval-harness/gating.md: usage and maintenance guide for thresholds

Design notes: - Gate semantics are conservative by default: only fail CI on regressions that exceed both an absolute delta and a statistical threshold (configurable). This avoids noisy fails for small metric variance. - Baselines: by default the workflow compares to the last merged baseline stored in eval-harness/artifacts/baselines/<branch>.json. For initial rollout the job treats missing baselines as warnings. - Reporting: the gate job posts a compact summary to the PR (comments disabled by default, uses Checks API) and uploads a detailed artifact with per-prompt diffs.

Review conversation (excerpt): - Aisha Patel (reviewer): "Great work. A couple suggestions: tighten up the CLI flags and ensure the collector works with streaming evals." - Sofia Chen (author): "Addressed: renamed flag to --per-prompt-output and added streaming support; added unit test for streaming path." - Miguel Torres (reviewer): "Can we make the thresholds per-prompt-set and not global?" - Sofia Chen: "Yes, added prompt_gates.yaml and per-prompt-set overrides; documented in gating.md." - Ethan Park (reviewer): "We should be careful about artifact size. Consider sampling for large prompt-sets." - Sofia Chen: "Added optional sampling and artifact compression; CI only uploads a compressed JSON diff for >1000 prompts."

CI status and runs: - New workflow eval-per-prompt-gate.yml created; runs on pull_request and schedule (nightly). - First run: failed on lint (flake8) — fixed in 4b7c9e. - Second run: unit tests passed, integration job ran with a small synthetic dataset; gate reported WARNING due to missing baseline on feature branch. - Final run (post fixes): all checks green; per-prompt metrics job completed in ~6m on hosted runner; artifact size 1.1MB compressed. - ci_status: pass (see metadata)

Backwards compatibility & rollout plan: - Default gate is opt-in for small teams; enabled for core/model-onboard teams in rollout phase 1. - Non-blocking mode available (set mode: warn) while teams tune thresholds. - Documented process to accept a baseline (eval-harness/scripts/accept_baseline.py).

Security/ops notes: - No secrets introduced. The workflow uses the existing checks/reporting token and writes artifacts to the standard GitHub Actions storage. - Added small rate-limiter in scripts/ci/per_prompt_gate.py to avoid API quota spikes when many PRs run concurrently.

Testing performed: - Unit tests for collector and gate logic. - Manual run of the workflow against a synthetic prompt-set. - Smoke test with streaming eval on a short model run.

Related work: ENG-10234 (per-prompt metrics), ENG-10456 (CI gating for evals). Also ties to docs task DOCS-453 for gating documentation.

Merge notes: - Squashed and merged by Aisha Patel after approvals from all reviewers. - Post-merge: enabled the workflow in the redwood repo for a small pilot team.
additional_notes: Artifacts stored under eval-harness/artifacts/per-prompt/<run_id>.json.gz; maintainers can run scripts/ci/per_prompt_gate.py --accept-baseline to seed baselines.
